# Three members, Carol added after Bob. Everyone sends, everyone reads everyone, and each next
# message acknowledges what its sender read. On namenlos, Carol's first message was read by both
# and never credited as acknowledged; a replica epoch passed during that run.

create alice g
join bob g
join carol g
run
invite alice g bob
run
invite alice g carol
run
send alice g hello from alice
send bob g hello from bob
send carol g hello from carol
run
send alice g alice read everyone
send bob g bob read everyone
send carol g carol read everyone
run
show carol g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group
carol ✓✓: hello from carol
alice: hello from alice
bob: hello from bob
carol ✓: carol read everyone
alice: alice read everyone
bob: bob read everyone

acked carol g
----
alice:1 bob:1

acked bob g
----
alice:1 carol:1
